Hello everyone! Trying to open Osek Patur on B1
Few weeks ago we managed to open osek patur for my girlfriend on B1 visa, and got the certificate after going to MAAM offices. Now our accountant told us we need to go to Mas Hachnasa offices to open her account there as well. We went and they gave her a user code for the website and said it’s only possible to open the file online. We logged in to mas hachnasa and now seeing this message. Anyone been on this situation before? Office says only on website, website says only in office.
